archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast (Archetype 4 adapted for Dark Mode)
design_philosophy: A command-center, technical-first interface for B2B sales reps. Avoids the 'bubbly' chat interface in favor of a stark, editorial 'terminal log' layout. High contrast, mono-spaced metadata, and strict bento grids for tool outputs.

layout.chat_container: max-w-4xl mx-auto w-full px-4 sm:px-8 pb-40 pt-12
layout.input_area: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 bg-[#09090B]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-white/10 p-4 sm:p-6 z-50

ChatThread.style: Vertical log format. No chat bubbles. Use generous vertical spacing (gap-12) between exchanges.

UserMessage.style: Massive text (text-3xl font-light) aligned left, taking up a maximum of 80% width. No background color.

AIResponse.style: Block layout containing metadata header, body text, and any tool-specific cards (like email drafts).

MetadataBadge.style: Sharp corners (rounded-none or rounded-sm), monospaced text, 1px solid borders. Colored based on context (Tool=Orange, Category=Cyan).

ActionCard_Gmail.style: Rectangular bento card for email drafts. Sharp borders. The 'Send via Gmail' button should use hover:bg-red-500/10 border border-red-500/20 text-red-400 rounded-sm w-full sm:w-auto.

InputBar.style: Deep surface bg (#121214), 1px border. Completely transparent inner input. Subtle glow on focus-within. Contains submit button and tool icons.

QuickActions.style: Horizontal flex row of chips positioned directly above the input bar. Sharp borders (border-white/15), dim text (text-zinc-400), brightens on hover.

TypingIndicator.style: Monospaced text 'PitchRoute is synthesizing...' with a blinking block cursor (animate-pulse on a solid w-2 h-4 rectangle), avoiding generic bouncing dots.

media.description: User avatar is a professional portrait. AI avatar is a stark, black-and-white abstract geometric texture to represent an AI system without using a cliché robot.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the PitchRoute chat UI using standard Shadcn components (ScrollArea, Input, Button, Badge) but heavily override their default Vercel-like styles to match the Archetype 4 Swiss Dark theme.

Banish chat bubbles. Do not use rounded colored backgrounds for messages. Use an editorial log layout where messages flow vertically like a document, separated by massive generous padding (py-8 or py-12).
User messages should use the heading font (Chivo) and be distinctly large (text-2xl or text-3xl) and font-light to create visual tension.
AI responses must always start with a horizontal bento-row of Metadata Badges (Model, Tool, Category) using JetBrains Mono text and respective border colors before showing the body text.
For the 'Send via Gmail' feature, render the email draft inside a dedicated bordered card (bg-[#121214]) with a prominent Gmail action button at the bottom.
Implement the 'TypingIndicator' as a technical terminal-style string ('PitchRoute is synthesizing...') rather than three bouncing dots.
The input bar should be housed in a sticky glassmorphic footer spanning the bottom of the screen, with Quick Action chips positioned horizontally just above the input field.
Ensure ALL interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='chat-input', data-testid='send-gmail-button', data-testid='metadata-badge').
Ensure all fonts (Chivo, IBM Plex Sans, JetBrains Mono) are imported from Google Fonts in index.css or App.css.
